paragraphs: Ulster University is a multi-campus public university in Northern Ireland, with major campuses in Belfast (new flagship Belfast Campus opened 2022), Coleraine (on the north Atlantic coast), Magee (Derry/Londonderry), and Jordanstown (sport sciences). Founded in 1968 (current form 1984), Ulster is the largest university in Northern Ireland with over 27,000 students. Strong in Nursing (#1 in NI), Business (Ulster Business School), Computing, Biomedical Sciences, and Art (Belfast School of Art).
International students enter via Oxford International pathway programmes — International Foundation, International Year One, and Pre-Master courses lead into Ulster Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
paragraphsRu: Ulster University — государственный многокампусный университет в Северной Ирландии. Главные кампусы: Belfast (новый флагман с 2022), Coleraine (на атлантическом побережье), Magee (Derry/Londonderry) и Jordanstown (sport sciences). Основан в 1968 (current form 1984). Крупнейший университет Северной Ирландии — более 27 000 студентов. Сильные направления — сестринское дело (#1 в NI), бизнес, computing, biomedical, art (Belfast School of Art).
Международные студенты заходят через pathway-программы Oxford International — International Foundation, International Year One и Pre-Master ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Ulster.
